subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should maintainers request a fresh current-main WSL transcript for the two Pi-tools suites after correcting the unrelated closing reference, or close this issue only once that evidence confirms the historical failures no longer occur?
rationale: The available evidence establishes the historical failure and an unrelated open closing PR, but does not include enough current-main WSL output to safely choose between a targeted repair and a cannot-reproduce close.

options.title: Request focused current-main WSL proof
options.body: Correct the unrelated closing reference and obtain a redacted focused run of both reported Pi-tools suites before selecting a repair or closure.

options.title: Close after maintainer verification
options.body: A maintainer who independently confirms the focused WSL suites pass on current main may close this issue as cannot reproduce.

recommendation.title: Request focused current-main WSL proof
recommendation.body: Correct the unrelated closing reference and obtain a redacted focused run of both reported Pi-tools suites before selecting a repair or closure.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior detailed review already defines the affected test boundary and is the strongest available routing signal.
